data.description:
## Context / Problem
Each of the ~8 review passes resolves a different prompt_id whose template embeds its own full copy of the plan (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py:232-245, _resolve_system at :276-293); the only shared bytes are the ~130-token preamble — below Anthropic's 1024-token cacheable minimum — so no cross-pass cache reuse exists. Timing data shows inter-pass gaps of 50-100ms, so a shared prefix written in Pass-1 stays warm through Pass-2 and Pass-4 under the default TTL. Separately, the incremental-depth problem (each BLOCK round exposing one more layer; e.g. the ticket-1867 three-round grind) needs an exhaustiveness instruction in the shared finder stance.

## Approach
Restructure the plan-review prompt templates so every pass's system prompt begins with an identical leading block: [shared preamble + plan material], followed by the pass-specific rubric text; the volatile-marker seam (src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py:349) is the existing partition mechanism. Wire Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verify first (the two biggest consumers); container/ISF/coach prompts follow the same shape where their template allows. Add one directive to the shared Pass-1 stance preamble: enumerate every independent defect found in this run; do not defer deeper findings to a later round. Alternative rejected: raising the cache TTL to 1 hour — measured pass gaps never approach the 5-minute refresh-on-hit window, and revise-loop re-reviews change the prefix bytes anyway, so the 2x write premium buys nothing.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py, the plan-review prompt templates under src/rebar/llm/ (finder/verifier prompt sources), tests/llm/test_shared_prefix.py.

## Testing
Unit: for one ticket, the Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verify system prompts share a byte-identical leading prefix containing the plan; the prefix exceeds 1024 estimated tokens for a typical plan fixture; the exhaustiveness directive is present in every Pass-1 request; rendered prompts for a fixture ticket differ from today only in section ordering (golden-file diff reviewed in the change).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verify system prompts for the same ticket share a byte-identical leading prefix that contains the full plan material (checked: unit test comparing rendered prompts).
- [ ] The shared Pass-1 preamble contains the exhaustiveness directive (checked: unit test asserting the directive text in every Pass-1 request).
- [ ] Review verdict behavior on the existing workflow test fixtures is unchanged (checked: existing plan-review tests pass).
data.title: Plan-first shared cache prefix across passes plus Pass-1 exhaustiveness directive
